title: Corrupted Totem
description: This project aims to make totems more balanced.
body:
Simple Minecraft mod to make it so whenever you pop a totem, your max health decreases by a full heart. This is for Hardcore enthusiasts that hate that totems make the challenge basically nil without removing totems alltogether.

Future updates (planned):
- minigame when on last life where you fight death itself to survive (configurable)
